items.title: E-commerce Platforms and Online Marketplaces (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of E-commerce Platforms and Online Marketplaces (PDF 133, printed 129).

blocks.text: E-commerce platforms aur online marketplaces karobar ko internet par products aur services bechne dete hain. Yeh physical dukaan ki zaroorat ke baghair bechne walon ko customers se milate hain. Yeh platforms khareedna bechna aasan, tez aur zyada logon ki pohanch mein bana dete hain. Misalon mein aisi websites aur apps hain jahan users products dekh sakte, qeematon ka muwazna kar sakte aur online order de sakte hain. Kharche kam kar ke aur market barha kar yeh digital entrepreneurship ki madad mein aham kirdar ada karte hain.

blocks.prompt: E-commerce platform physical dukaan se kaise mukhtalif hai, aur yeh entrepreneurs ki kaise madad karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Is mein dukaan ki zaroorat nahi; seller aur gahak internet par milte hain, gahak products dekhte, qeematein milate aur online order dete hain. Yeh kharch kam aur market ki rasai zyada karta hai.

items: E-commerce: internet par khareed-farokht, physical store ke baghair.
